# Setup Instructions

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `1a80fc8`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


This document provides step-by-step instructions to set up and run the MLightCAD project, including prerequisites, installation, and configuration.

## Prerequisites

Before setting up the project, ensure you have the following installed on your machine:

- **Node.js**: Version 24 or later. You can download it from [nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/).
- **PNPM**: Version 10 or later. Install it globally using the following command:
  ```bash
  npm install -g pnpm@10
  ```

## Installation

Follow these steps to set up the project locally:

1. **Clone the Repository**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/mlightcad/cad-viewer
   cd cad-viewer
   ```

2. **Install Dependencies**
   Use PNPM to install the project dependencies.
   ```bash
   pnpm install
   ```

## Configuration

This project does not specify any environment variables in the provided configuration files. Ensure that your environment satisfies the prerequisites.

## Running the Project

To run the project, you can use various scripts defined in `package.json`. Here are some common commands:

- **Development Mode**: Run the development server for the main example.
  ```bash
  pnpm dev
  ```

- **Build the Project**: Compile the project for production.
  ```bash
  pnpm build
  ```

- **Serve the Project**: Serve the compiled project.
  ```bash
  pnpm serve
  ```

- **Preview the Project**: Preview the project in a pre-production environment.
  ```bash
  pnpm preview
  ```

## Running Tests

The project uses Jest for testing. To run the tests, execute the following command:

- **Run All Tests**:
  ```bash
  pnpm test
  ```

- **Run End-to-End Tests**:
  ```bash
  pnpm test:e2e
  ```

## Additional Commands

- **Linting and Formatting**: Check and fix code style issues.
  ```bash
  pnpm lint
  pnpm format
  ```

- **Generate Documentation**: Build the project documentation.
  ```bash
  pnpm docs:all
  ```

- **Release Management**: Manage project versions and releases.
  ```bash
  pnpm release
  ```

Refer to the `package.json` file for a complete list of available scripts and their purposes.
